label: b2_before_warm
note: probe_wall_s is the authoritative latency. Per-statement wall times come from SQLAlchemy cursor hooks, which close when cursor.execute() returns — for a query that needs a sorter or an aggregate that is the whole cost, but for a streaming query part of the cost lands in fetch and is therefore UNDER-reported at the statement level. Compare probes by probe_wall_s; use the statement rows for the plan, not for a cost total.
